comment: mon.c angry_guards() (5711-5767), the arm for guards the hero cannot spot: You_hear("the shrill sound of %s whistle%s."). The hero level-teleports to Minetown, wishes for a fountain underfoot, puts on a blindfold and quaffs. fountain.c dryup() first warns ("The flow reduces to a trickle."), then the next quaff dries the fountain in town and calls angry_guards(FALSE).
